requirements.title: ARM64 loader and low-address reservation
requirements.reusable_source: Wine accepts aarch64/ARM64EC PE build targets and has host loader/reservation code. The selected aarch64 configuration does not select the old Mac preloader.
requirements.remaining_work: Define the native loader layout, signed app launch and process creation strategy using the measured host facilities. The inspected Wine configuration requests a 4 KiB PAGEZERO (-pagezero_size,0x1000), whereas the qualified Issue #2 probe used the emulation layout with a protected 64 KiB PAGEZERO; reconcile and verify the actual loader rather than copying either blindly. The unsupported-CPU branch in the optional preloader is not itself proof that every ARM64 build must use or port that preloader.
requirements.future_verification: Inspect actual ARM64 Mach-O layout; reserve/map the required low address ranges before PE loading; verify each required child uses the intended layout under normal protections.

requirements.title: Guest/host x18 transitions and callbacks
requirements.reusable_source: Wine ARM64 assembly saves/restores x18 and provides syscall/callback entry points; Apple ARM64 signal context definitions already exist.
requirements.remaining_work: Integrate explicit custom-x18 mode transitions before ordinary macOS calls, restore guest state only after foreign-mode entry, and cover nested callbacks, error exits and asynchronous entry. Exact new Apple API spellings were not found in the selected tracked trees; this is not a claim about all branches or alternate implementations.
requirements.future_verification: Exercise native/translated calls in both directions, nested callbacks, host logging/allocation, signal entry and error exits while checking x18/mode restoration; finite Issue #2 thunks do not qualify these runtime paths.

requirements.title: 4 KiB guest memory and process page geometry
requirements.reusable_source: Wine distinguishes its 4 KiB page bookkeeping from the aarch64 host page size and contains protection/commit paths.
requirements.remaining_work: Wire process creation to the selected 4 KiB user-page mode and reconcile reserve/protect/decommit/recommit/guard behavior with Wine and FEX. Host probe success does not change the selected source automatically.
requirements.future_verification: Verify 4 KiB geometry for actual runtime children, independent adjacent-page protection/faults/recommit, low mappings and Windows allocation edge cases.

requirements.title: Wine ARM64EC/WoW64 translator interfaces
requirements.reusable_source: Wine loads an ARM64EC emulator module, obtains lifecycle/memory/exception callbacks, and has the separate WoW64 BTCpu interface. FEX supplies Windows module lifecycle, context reconstruction and Wine UnixLib loading code.
requirements.remaining_work: Select matching module/UnixLib names, exports and versions; integrate the host ports and prove actual FEX selection. The Wine source tag used for DXMT linking is not a functioning runtime according to its publisher.
requirements.future_verification: Load an identifiable FEX module into native ARM64 Wine and run x64 plus required x86 smoke tests with explicit module/process attribution and no Rosetta fallback.

requirements.title: FEX native host service boundary
requirements.reusable_source: FEX Windows UnixLib has a small function-table boundary for memory-model policy, mapping, advisory controls and statistics; the Windows module avoids requiring the full Linux application loader.
requirements.remaining_work: Implement a Darwin host side or explicitly disable optional facilities with correct errors. The selected UnixLib includes sys/prctl.h, calls Linux prctl operations, emits .so targets and links rt; it is not a ready Darwin implementation.
requirements.future_verification: Build and inspect native ARM64 host libraries; validate every used UnixLib call, mapping/file lifetime, optional capability refusal and cleanup from the real Windows module.

requirements.title: Per-thread x86 ordering and software fallback
requirements.reusable_source: FEX has a configurable software TSO path and a hardware-support switch; its Windows boundary attempts hardware TSO through UnixLib.
requirements.remaining_work: The inspected UnixLib implements Linux prctl policy, while macOS requires a separate per-thread policy operation. FEX disables several software-emulation paths when hardware support is selected; do not set a context-wide hardware flag unless all participating threads satisfy the policy or retain a correct fallback.
requirements.future_verification: Check each actual thread initialization/error/cleanup path, distinguish API return from finite behavior, and test software fallback and unaligned/atomic behavior without treating zero finite litmus outcomes as a universal proof.

requirements.title: Executable code allocation, cache visibility and invalidation
requirements.reusable_source: FEX uses Windows allocation/protection APIs, EC-code attributes and memory invalidation callbacks; Wine contains instruction-cache and guest memory machinery.
requirements.remaining_work: Specify the macOS JIT code-cache allocation/write/execute/cache-flush/lifetime contract with signing. The selected source does not contain the exact MAP_JIT or pthread_jit_write_protect_np tokens searched. Do not replace every PE or guest RWX mapping with MAP_JIT indiscriminately.
requirements.future_verification: Run translated code generation, code patching/self-modification, fault-triggered invalidation, concurrent execution/reclamation and required cache flushes through actual Wine/FEX under verified entitlements.

requirements.title: Signals, exceptions, suspension and guest reconstruction
requirements.reusable_source: Wine has Apple ARM64 integer/FPU signal-context handling, signal registration and syscall fault handling. FEX reconstructs guest state and handles access/guard/invalidation cases.
requirements.remaining_work: Audit the new host ABI gateway through actual POSIX/Mach faults, Windows SEH/unwind and asynchronous suspend/resume. Existing code and Issue #2 controlled SIGUSR1/error-return probes are not a complete Windows exception proof.
requirements.future_verification: Exercise fault address/PC, nested SEH, stack unwind, guard pages, interrupt/suspend and precise translated-state resumption across host/guest callbacks.

requirements.title: DXMT/Wine graphics export and structure compatibility
requirements.reusable_source: DXMT supports both a macdrv_functions table and individual-symbol fallback. An existing public Wine export patch is available and its original application was reproduced.
requirements.remaining_work: The patch does not apply to either selected Wine tree. More importantly, DXMT expects a window-data structure prefix with cocoa_view and client_cocoa_view, while both selected Wine headers have client_view followed by rects. Exporting names alone does not repair that layout contract.
requirements.future_verification: Define and implement a matching driver ABI, then test window creation, device/presentation, resize, teardown, repeated view lifetime and callback transitions using open x64 D3D11 programs.

requirements.title: ARM64EC PE plus native Metal/shader components
requirements.reusable_source: DXMT has ARM64EC cross settings, native ARM64 LLVM shader build rules, matching Wine-linked winemetal pieces and native Metal callback code.
requirements.remaining_work: Reconcile LLVM 15 shader-library and LLVM-MinGW compiler roles, exact tool/SDK inputs and native/PE output pairing; audit callbacks such as Metal shared-event delivery into NtSetEvent for the chosen Wine ABI mode.
requirements.future_verification: Reproduce builds and inspect headers/dependencies, then validate shaders/readback/synchronization/presentation and callback mode correctness before game qualification.

findings.finding: Archive Wine VERSION identifies Wine 11.0. This is a member value, not proof of an exact upstream base commit or ARM64 Preview provenance.

The ARM64 signal source contains Apple ucontext register/FPU handling. Do not report the archive as having no Apple ARM64 code. These branches alone do not establish the required custom-x18 ABI transitions or runtime correctness.

The inspected Mac preloader implements i386/x86_64 assembly and has an unsupported-CPU error. It is not a native ARM64 preloader implementation; whether a final configuration uses it is a separate loader decision.

No exact new x18/4KiB spawn/thread TSO/layout/entitlement spellings were found in the declared Wine text scope. MAP_JIT has one unrelated dbghelp constant match. This does not prove semantic absence across binary/excluded members or other source releases.

The inspected aarch64 virtual-memory path records ordinary host geometry from sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE). Actual 4KiB process setup and sub-page behavior require a coherent loader/runtime implementation and tests, not reuse of the host-probe result alone.

The archive is an aggregate source tree with vendor modifications (for example a bundle-name override). No ordered ARM64 Preview patch series or exact base was established by this member inspection. Do not synthesize patch identities or equate vendor archive availability with complete Preview source.
